prompt: Start a multi-file migration that changes schemas and tests. Define what is in scope, what is out, stop conditions, and verification before touching anything.
What is 2 + 2?
One screen shows the wrong balance. Before patching it, trace the mechanism and check every sibling consumer for the same failure class.
Change this button label from Save to Done.
These fields mix vendor estimates, user attestations, derived values, and missing values. Tell me what we are actually allowed to claim.
Rewrite this paragraph to sound clearer.
The owner already chose option B yesterday. A new worker wants to ask again. Preserve the active decision unless newer conflicting evidence exists.
Give me three naming ideas for this feature.
Audit this PR against the task and explain every changed hunk, including unrelated cleanup and protected files.
Explain what a pull request is.
This change reaches a locked accounting writer and production migration. Determine whether we have authority to cross that boundary.
Format this JSON alphabetically.
We have been polishing a low-priority tool for two days while the launch blocker remains open. Check whether this work still serves the stated objective.
Summarize today's completed tasks.
The dashboard total is wrong. Audit whether the source data, state, or UI presentation is actually responsible before redesigning anything.
Make this marketing hero visually bolder.
Trace these deposits, withdrawals, transfers, fees, and settlements by source, destination, and economic meaning. Do not infer meaning from sign alone.
Convert $20 to euros using the provided fixed rate.
All ledger rows pass schema validation, but shares, cash, basis, dates, and realized P&L may contradict each other. Test whether the records can all be true at once.
Validate that this JSON has the required keys and types.
Calculate portfolio return, but first determine whether deposits, withdrawals, valuation gaps, and stale prices contaminate the period and which return method is valid.
What percentage of the portfolio is in cash right now?
Prove realized gain on this sale by replaying acquisition lots. Missing basis must not become zero.
What is the current market value of 10 shares at $25 each?
We need to correct historical trades. Preview downstream effects on cash, positions, basis, realized P&L, and performance before any ledger mutation.
Explain why this old trade looks suspicious without changing anything.
Reconcile account-to-account movements so paired internal transfers net to zero external portfolio flow, and leave unpaired legs unresolved.
Classify this clearly documented external payroll deposit.
Canonical cash is nonzero but the mirror row is missing. Determine the honest reconciliation state without treating absence as zero.
Add the values in this complete cash table.
Grade statement data, filings, user input, deterministic derivations, vendor estimates, LLM research, and missing sources by provenance and downstream authority.
Summarize this already-authoritative audited financial statement.
A distribution was paid, but only a preliminary notice describes its tax character. Separate observed cash from authoritative tax treatment and basis impact.
Add these already-final ordinary dividend amounts from a 1099-DIV.
A split and symbol change occurred. Preserve shares, lots, basis, and holding-period continuity unless the economics actually changed.
Record a normal open-market purchase of a new security.
Attack this forecast from accounting identities, units, probability bounds, sensitivity direction, and independent recomputation before trusting the output.
Format this already-validated model output as a table.
Before publishing performance, realized P&L, tax analytics, and attribution, decide which underlying books are ready and block only outputs contaminated by unresolved domains.
Show the current allocation percentages from a complete trusted snapshot.
